mapper.select: INSERT INTO research_history (id, workspace_key, question, source_ids, snapshot) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspace}, #{question}, CAST(#{sources} AS jsonb), CAST(#{snapshot} AS jsonb)) RETURNING id, question, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO research_requests (workspace_key, request_key, fingerprint, status, checkpoint_token_digest, checkpoint_scope, question) VALUES (#{workspace}, #{key}, #{fingerprint}, 'RUNNING', #{digest}, CAST(#{scope} AS jsonb), #{question}) ON CONFLICT (workspace_key, request_key) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO research_requests (workspace_key, request_key, fingerprint, status, checkpoint_token_digest, checkpoint_scope, checkpoint_trace, checkpoint_context, resume_from, input_fingerprint, question) SELECT workspace_key, #{key}, #{fingerprint}, 'RUNNING', #{digest}, checkpoint_scope, checkpoint_trace, checkpoint_context, request_key, COALESCE(input_fingerprint, fingerprint), question FROM research_requests WHERE workspace_key = #{workspace} AND request_key = #{parent} AND status = 'UNKNOWN' AND checkpoint_context IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN r.status = 'RUNNING' AND r.expires_at <= clock_timestamp() THEN 'UNKNOWN' ELSE r.status END AS status, r.question, r.checkpoint_scope, r.checkpoint_trace, r.record_id, r.checkpoint_context IS NOT NULL AS has_checkpoint, child.request_key AS next_key FROM research_requests r LEFT JOIN research_requests child ON child.workspace_key = r.workspace_key AND child.resume_from = r.request_key WHERE r.workspace_key = #{workspace} AND r.request_key = #{key} AND r.question IS NOT NULL AND r.checkpoint_scope IS NOT NULL
